failure_modes: Adopting a temporal_teacher_blend or temporal_region_index edit without a validated contrast function could shift regional attention toward sign-conflicted landmark regions, causing unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates and oscillatory coordinate motion within the observed window.

Increasing pointcloud_delta_A (C002/C003) without evidence of affinity gain could enlarge endpoint-VJP displacement, raising strain/clash constraint pressure while the primary affinity objective remains unimproved.
Reading whole-window z summaries as absolute geometric targets would misstate the weak net window-level contrast as a reward target.
Treating a temporal derivative or rate reversal as a spatial gradient would misdirect the coordinate reward.
rationale: D1.2: The registered time-conditioned alternatives (C008 temporal_region_index, C009/C010/C011 temporal_teacher_blend) change regional attention or blend a validated observed-node coordinate teacher; they do not change the static teacher coordinates themselves and are not velocity forces. Analyst's temporal evidence (F001-F003, H001-H002) shows the contrast functions are observed-node linear fits over [0.0,0.5] with no accepted polynomial and no extrapolation, and that landmark local contrasts have multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts with first-to-last rate reversals. That supports the plausibility of a time-conditioned rule within the observed support, but the evidence is coordinate-contrast only and the whole-window z values are small relative to endpoint rate z (F004), so no defensible expected affinity advantage is established. D4.1: Compared with the incumbent (teacher_neighbors=4, pointcloud_delta_A=1.0, static regional attention, no temporal blend), the offered edits are either dose changes (C001-C003 pointcloud_delta_A) or attention/teacher changes (C004-C011). The incumbent already sits at the registered teacher_neighbors=4 and delta=1.0 defaults, and the evidence provides no validated contrast function or decoded terminal label showing that any offered alternative improves final predicted affinity. Under the affinity-first objective, an unvalidated attention or dose change is not justified, so retaining the incumbent is the defensible choice. D4.2: The concrete failure mode of adopting a time-conditioned blend or larger dose without validated contrast is unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates: the sign-conflicted landmark local features (e.g. 10 sign changes / 7 strong sign conflicts) would drive attention toward regions whose contrast direction reverses within the window, producing oscillatory or misdirected displacement of neighboring coordinates and risking strain/clash constraint pressure, while the primary affinity objective is not demonstrably improved. Because coordinate graph changes alone are not a failure mechanism and no affinity benefit is evidenced, this prediction supports retaining the incumbent rather than editing.
